done_when: test_sim_planted_edge.py passes, and fails when stop_first is flipped in a scratch copy; result line states trades matched 20 of 20.
goal: Validate the tom_bt simulator end to end: a planted edge must be recovered, a fee-including null must give the negative net the fees imply, and the trade list must equal a hand-built expected list (operator q16).

steps: Build synthetic 1m Bars1m (style of test_tom_bt.mk): 20 signals, 12 hit the target and 8 hit the stop, by construction.
Include 2 bars where one bar touches both stop and target; expect the stop fill (stop_first=True); the mutation test flips stop_first and must then fail on exactly those bars.
Expected net R per trade and the mean computed by hand from fees.py rates (write the arithmetic in the test); assert run_variant output equals the expected list trade by trade.
Null: flat-noise bars, same signals; assert mean net R equals minus the round-turn fee in R within 0.01.
Planted: assert the recovered mean net R equals the hand value within 1e-9.
tests: test_sim_planted_edge.py: expected numbers hand-derived, never from run_variant; a one-line mutation (stop_first flipped) must fail it.
title: Simulator validation: planted edge in tom_bt/sim, a null that includes fees, a trade-list diff (q16)
